strings.name: Sting
strings.summary: Born Gordon Sumner, Sting moved from teaching and jazz in northeast England to fronting the Police and a solo career. He brings rock, jazz and music from different regions into pop songwriting. The Last Ship connects his hometown’s shipbuilding memory with musical theatre; his public work also supports rainforests and Indigenous communities.
